div.div: What should I wear with white sneakers?
the nearest chunks or products by meaning
The model writes from these pieces. It has what looks or sounds alike, and no relation between them.
From the matching nodes, you decide which relations to follow and how far: the garment, the looks it is in, what else is worn there, the occasion. That is the richer context.

div.span: embedding similarity, then a walk through the graph

div.div: the matching nodes, where the walk starts
The model writes from the looks. Each suggestion names the look it came from, so you can check it.
